limitations: A stored or recovered checkpoint is heuristic_candidate state. Only protected independent Finish can publish accepted complete-cover evidence.
Payloads are limited to 1 MiB, manifests to 64 KiB and symbols to 16 KiB. Ordinary envelope admission can refuse near its maximum because of JSON expansion.
Repair encoding and restoration require explicitly funded ordinary work. Restore reserves a decoder and an encoder pass; the unchanged default CLI allowance intentionally refuses repair encoding.
Sixteen repair symbols do not guarantee recovery for every sixteen-loss pattern. Invalid or missing manifests, insufficient or dependent equations and source-validation failures refuse.
Failure before manifest publication can leave at most 80 unreferenced committed symbol records per attempt. There is no garbage collector or automatic disk repair daemon.
Synchronization errors after rename can leave a visible record despite an error. Exact-key inspection/retry is required; publication is not claimed absent in that case.

The local directory is a host-controlled capability. This is not a whole-session snapshot, hostile-filesystem race guarantee, asynchronous cancellation endpoint, certified persistence profile or complete campaign recovery gate.
